definitions.explanation: A high-pitched voice produced by vibrating only the edges of the vocal cords, as opposed to one's normal chest voice.

examples.japanese: {裏声|うらごえ}で{歌|うた}った。
この{曲|きょく}はサビで{裏声|うらごえ}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: This song uses falsetto in the chorus.

examples.japanese: カラオケで{高|たか}い{曲|きょく}を{歌|うた}おうとしたら{裏声|うらごえ}になってしまった。
examples.english: When I tried to sing a high-pitched song at karaoke, my voice flipped into falsetto.

notes:
USAGE: {裏声|うらごえ} literally means 'back voice' or 'reverse voice,' contrasting with {地声|じごえ} (natural voice, chest voice). Common in music and singing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏声|うらごえ}で{歌|うた}う: to sing in falsetto
- {裏声|うらごえ}を{使|つか}う: to use falsetto
- {裏声|うらごえ}になる: to flip into falsetto
- {裏声|うらごえ}が{出|で}る: to be able to produce falsetto

CONTRAST: {裏声|うらごえ} (falsetto) vs. {地声|じごえ} (natural/chest voice).
